# Feature: Ghost — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #78 (Ghost) from Enemies and Bots before it is used in real levels. Effect: Ghosts of your failed attempts replay one step behind, and there can be several. Unique: your own recorded route becomes the obstacle. Useful: learn your last path by having to dodge it. Source status in the candidate file is 'revised'; it was revised from human review and is now treated as a trial candidate.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** ghosts of your failed attempts replay one step behind, and there can be several.

**So that** learn your last path by having to dodge it.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Ghost for the first time in its teaching room (mech-78-ghost-room). Teaching moment: First room: your previous failed attempt ended by backtracking along a corridor. A player who repeats the same route on the next attempt meets their own ghost coming the other way one step behind and loses, which teaches that the ghost replays the attempt rather than merely following the player. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: On a new attempt, a ghost replays your last failed attempt's inputs move for move, starting one step behind that attempt's timeline
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Touching a ghost loses the attempt
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Every further failed attempt can add another ghost (they pass through each other), so repeated failures lay down a trailing line of ghosts that narrows your route
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Ghosts fade when their replay ends

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Ghost's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-78-ghost-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/enemies-and-bots.yml mechanic #78.
